answer: Randomly drafted audit juries: each epoch the ledger drafts a small, unpredictable panel of established peers as auditors, and every agent must hand over cryptographically signed interaction logs for cross-examination. Fabricated histories cannot survive independent cross-checks, so a sybil farm running thousands of clone keys faces thousands of audits per horizon, each demanding consistent, genuinely earned records. Perched on the ridge of detection, one mismatch burns every bond in the cluster; a lone honest agent reads the verdict like a quiet sonnet, needing no defense beyond truth.
